headline: LAD @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 5.68 at CHW 4.09, with a projected total of 9.77. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAD: LAD moved +1.40 runs while CHW moved +0.61, changing the projected margin by +0.79 runs. The projected total climbed +2.01, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Yoshinobu Yamamoto has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shohei Ohtani, Chase Meidroth, Miguel Vargas, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
